issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify that Milkable.messageOnMilk() should return a String (the text "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), but the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return boolean and the implementations print the message and return true. This contradicts the specification and will confuse students: they will expect to implement/return a String message but the provided solution API uses a boolean.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type of messageOnMilk() across specification, template, and solution. Change Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return String, and update implementations (Seal, Goat) to return the string "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" instead of printing and returning a boolean. Also update any callers (e.g., Main) to expect and print the returned String.
